rows.grounds: compound śriyaḥ (Śrī/fortune) + pitan (father/lord, vocative); epithet of Viṣṇu/Rāma as consort/lord of Śrī
compound mahā (great) + vījaṃ/bījaṃ (seed-syllable, bīja); refers to the principal mantra-seed
possibly tat (that) + ānatam (bowed/humbled); segmentation and exact sense uncertain without fuller passage context
verb uc-car (to utter/recite); enjoins recitation of the mantra
